name: Campingplatz Alpenwelt Tannheimer Tal
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Alpenwelt is situated on the edge of Tannheim in the scenic Tannheimer Tal valley at around 1,100 metres above sea level. The property features direct access to Lake Tannheimer See, enveloped by gentle alpine pastures and striking mountain ranges. Guests benefit from well-kept pitches for motorhomes and tents, modern sanitary blocks, and an on-site shop. The region is ideal for hiking and cycling in summer, as well as picturesque winter walks.
